title: She arrived in the US at 21 with little money, working as a stadium food server to pay for school. Forbes just named her one of the world's top innovators at 53.

sources.text: American Bazaar - Seven Indian American women on Forbes 50 Over 50 list
Forbes Australia - Forbes 2026 50 Over 50: Meet the women who define innovation, drive and hope

caption:
She arrived in the US at 21 with little money, working as a stadium food server to pay for school. Forbes just named her one of the world's top innovators at 53.

The sixth annual list, produced by Forbes with Mika Brzezinski's Know Your Value initiative, honours 200 women across four categories - Rangan featured among the Innovation honourees.

After working customer-facing roles at SAP, Workday and Dropbox, she became HubSpot's CEO in 2021, guiding the software company past $3 billion in annual revenue.

Rangan's path from an Indian engineering degree to a stadium food-service job to a Fortune-recognized CEO shows Indian technical training compounding into leadership decades later.
